basics.name: Alejandro Cabeza
basics.label: Software Engineer | Full Stack
basics.summary: Software engineer with over 7 years of experience designing and deploying end-to-end web applications, ranging from high-performance reactive interfaces to scalable backend architectures. Specialized in building decoupled systems, modern reactive/SPA applications, and robust APIs following SOLID principles and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Proven track record integrating complex frontend components using TypeScript and reactive frameworks, optimizing relational and non-relational databases, and implementing continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines with Docker containers.

work.name: WallsTeam
